name: If Those Kids Could Read They'd Be Very Upset
look: Two stacked panels from King of the Hill. Top: Bobby Hill tapes a blank sign to a classroom window and points at it with a smug look. Bottom: a man in a purple striped shirt, clutching torn-down signs, talks to Bobby as kids stare out the window. Subtitle: "If those kids could read they'd be very upset".
text: If those kids could read they'd be very upset
use: Roasts a group that would never notice the roast. The sign holds a jab at people who don't read, pay attention or do the homework, and the kids in the window are labeled as that group.
